verdict.rationale: Qodo's docs say it connects to your Git provider and automatically reviews every pull request, posting findings and chat directly in PRs, with native labels on GitHub and GitLab; a community user also describes using its review bot for two years. The evidence never says the findings are native inline line comments, never describes the install as a GitHub/GitLab app, and never gives a turnaround time. missing for 10: explicit documentation of inline line-level review comments, GitHub/GitLab app install mechanics, evidence that reviews arrive within minutes, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the reviewer installs as a GitHub/GitLab app and posts reviews as native inline comments on my pull requests within minutes

citations.quote: Connect Qodo to your Git provider to enable automated code reviews directly in your pull requests.
Once connected, Qodo automatically reviews every pull request
Qodo makes this classification available as a native pull request tag (Azure DevOps) or label (GitHub, GitLab)
Chat with Qodo to interact with Qodo directly inside pull requests.
